summary: Orphaned warmup charge attributed to deleted API key after postback retry storm
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports an unexpected invoice line for a warmup credit that appears to have been charged to a deleted API key (key id: acct-prod-key-zzzx). The charge shows up as a separate warmup line on the finalized invoice for the last billing period. Customer is asking for an explanation and provisional credit while we investigate.

Impact:
- A single finalized invoice included a $48.23 warmup charge tagged to a deleted key and the customer's cost center.
- Customer (Cartwheel Health) says the key was deleted prior to the warmup run and they did not run any warmup from that org during the period.
- This affects billing reconciliation for their dedicated allocation; they are requesting an audit export and provisional credit.

Environment:
- Dedicated tenancy: cartwheel-prod (tenant-id: t-cart-998)
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer deleted API key acct-prod-key-zzzx on 2026-03-03 via Console.
2) On 2026-03-04 between 02:00-03:30 UTC a flood of postback retries was observed for that tenant (postback queue: async-archive-retry).
3) Postback aggregator processed replays and one warmup postback included a tag that mapped to the deleted key prefix and flowed into hourly metering.
4) Finalized invoice (period ending 2026-03-07) contains warmup charge line referencing the key prefix and cartwheel cost center.

Relevant logs/snippets:
- postback-reconciler lines (timestamps UTC):
  - 2026-03-04T02:12:03Z reconciler: INFO postback received key_prefix=acct-prod-key-zzzx fingerprint=ab12cd ttl=300 status=retry
  - 2026-03-04T02:12:03Z metering:DEBUG create_line_item type=warmup tags=[warmup,kv_cache] org=t-cart-998 key_prefix=acct-prod-key-zzzx amount=48.23
- console audit: key deletion recorded 2026-03-03T17:05:12Z by user:ellen.park@cartwheel.health
- billing ledger: invoice-2026-03-07 line 12: warmup kv_cache acct-prod-key-zzzx cost_center=cartwheel-prod amount=48.23

Investigation notes so far:
- Initial hypothesis: retry storm caused late postbacks to be processed after key deletion; dedupe used key-prefix only, and because the deleted key was later re-created with same prefix in another internal operation, the postback reconciler associated the warmup with the active cost center.
- SRE (Diego Alvarez) identified a fingerprint collision window in the reconciler where dedupe keys omitted api_key_uuid, relying only on key_prefix which can be re-used by customers. Patch proposed to include api_key_uuid in dedupe fingerprint (PR linked above).
- Billing ops (Sofia Patel) confirmed ledger shows warmup line attached to tenant cost center and that the charge cleared finalization process (invoice finalized) before a scheduled reconciliation backfill could run.

Customer request / desired outcome:
- Explanation of why the warmup charge is on their finalized invoice despite the key deletion.
- Provisional credit while engineering confirms root cause and provides a permanent fix.
- Audit export showing postbacks and reconciler decisions for 2026-03-04 02:00-04:00 UTC.

Proposed remediation and next steps:
- Short term: Billing to issue provisional credit for $48.23 and mark as pending adjustment on the customer's account. (Billing action assigned to Sofia Patel).
- Short/medium term: Postback reconciler to be patched to include api_key_uuid in dedupe fingerprint and to ignore postbacks referencing deleted api keys post-deletion timestamp. (Engineer: Diego Alvarez).
- Backfill: Run reconciliation that re-tags late postbacks to original api_key_uuid if available or mark them as orphaned and remove charged line items from finalized ledger with a correcting credit.
- Postmortem: Document in Confluence and add a monitoring alert for large retry storms that intersect with key deletes.

Resolution notes (to be populated):
- 2026-03-13 Billing provisional credit of $48.23 issued (adjustment id: ADJ-2026-8819).
- PR merged to postback-reconciler to include api_key_uuid in dedupe and a postback-ignore-on-deleted-key window added.
- Reconciliation job scheduled for 2026-03-14 to scan for similar events across last 30 days.
